scope: Carry live Smart Notifications and its authenticated subscription API into the Native OpenUI Workspace release candidate.

keep: Native OpenUI generation and recovery, live notification consent, recipient scope and first-party API transport.
extend: Carry the production notification code and pinned dependencies into the release candidate. Exercise subscription ownership with two isolated authenticated accounts.

schemaImpact.rollout: Apply additive RLS-protected table in isolated staging, verify role denial, then production before enabling push endpoints.
schemaImpact.rollback: Revert API/frontend to prior revision and disable VAPID bindings; preserve subscription rows until opt-outs and cleanup are reviewed. No table drop.

auth.description: Push subscription endpoints require existing authenticated API middleware; no anonymous subscription route.

tenant.description: Subscriptions are stored and queried only by authenticated tenant user ID; browser roles have no table access.

approval.description: Browser permission and explicit user switch are required; no auto-subscribe on page load.

credentials.description: VAPID public/private values stored in Secret Manager; private value never reaches browser.

egress.description: Server sends generic push payloads only to validated public browser push-service hosts.

cost.description: Small outbound push requests and Cloud Run work; at most ten subscriptions queried per notification.

tests.scope: Verify accepted browser push-service subscription formats and destination validation.
Verify authenticated subscription creation, update and deletion and verify that a different account cannot modify or delete the subscription.
Verify the live sound preview plays the chime without opting the user into future sound alerts.

architecture.reason: Uses existing notification persistence, tenant API, and completion event writers; no new scheduler or notification inbox.

rollout: Verify exact-source builds and account isolation. Preserve the live VAPID bindings and the existing table during the OpenUI rollout.
rollback: Restore the prior notification-capable API and frontend with compatible native answer decoding. Preserve subscription rows and existing VAPID bindings.
knownGaps: Hosted Native OpenUI generation and rollback require verification on the combined candidate.
placeholderClaimsRemaining: No live closed-page delivery has yet been verified

blockers: Combined-source authenticated CI and private hosted OpenUI acceptance pending.
